items.title: Eaton Just Dropped 16% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysEaton stock fell 16% in the past month as AI-power stocks sold off, and GE Vernova and Vertiv fell too. The worst drop came after Meta raised its 2026 capex plans and its free cash flow turned negative.

items.title: Eaton earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Eaton Corporation PLC (ETN) reported Q3 2026 on Nov 3, 2026. The stock traded at $387.76 (+5.93%) as of 12:50 PM EST. That is about 19% below its 52-week high of $478. The shares had fallen roughly 11% over the prior month, so the print worked as a relief rally.

items.title: Vertiv Soars 6%, Eaton Up 7% as Bernstein Calls Election-Day Data Center Fears Overblown
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVertiv stock jumped 6% after Bernstein called the political risk to US data-center construction overstated. Bernstein expects developers to pay more for power as projects go ahead.

items.title: Eaton Earnings Are Rock Solid. It Won’t Be Enough to Ease AI Concerns.
items.summary: Tuesday, Eaton reported third-quarter earnings per share of $3.68 from sales of $8.9 billion. Wall Street was looking for EPS of $3.54 from sales of $8.5 billion.
